status: Declared before the real-map comparison; follows manufactured direction and population-accounting tests
population: Existing central occupation settlement base on recognised claimed land; changing markets must not change population or political held/claimed totals
costs: Unchanged Price Edict sea/river/road network, scale 270 road-km, months 0/3/6/9; compare catchments in month 6, matching the historical export
preparation: Reconstruct existing trade inputs without recalculating political reach; require exact agreement with cached export arrays for land, terrain, density, claims, cell size and town nodes before analysis
catchments: All unique physical town nodes; compare historical outward access with cell-to-town inbound access; merge settlement records snapped onto the same node explicitly
routes: Bounded diagnostic on the 12 largest historical catchment towns; compare full ordered gravity routes, and require invariance after reversing town records. Do not claim that a 12-town subset is the complete world trade network
report: Reachable and unassigned population; share of assigned people changing market; town-rank correlation; count of merged duplicate settlement nodes; directed route permutation error; maps of changed market assignments
adoption: Accounting, input identity and permutation checks are necessary. This comparison does not validate town sizes, tonnes or historical population and does not change the published atlas layers automatically. A separate Earth test is required before claiming predictive demographic improvement.
